firstrun.title: Data location
firstrun.intro: Choose where this tool stores its config, cache and logs (delete that folder to clean everything up):
firstrun.portable_desc: Stored in a data folder next to the program; deleting the program folder removes everything — good if you delete the tool after use.
firstrun.userdir_desc: Stored in the system user data directory; your config survives moving or upgrading the program.

cs.err_no_decryptor:
Decryptor module not found.

This tool bundles _vendor/tg_scoop and it should normally be present; make sure tg-picker\_vendor\tg_scoop\cache_decryptor.py exists, or set the TG_SCOOP_SRC environment variable to a directory containing the tg_scoop package.
